exposure: FSGS superimposed on immunglobulin A (IgA) nephropathy
outcome: Impact of pregnancy on primary glomerular disease
cohort: 10 pregnant women (11 pregnancies) with primary glomerular diseases
finding: Primary glomerular disease has an adverse impact on perinatal outcome, with 72.7% of pregnancies complicated with IUGR, fetal distress and preterm delivery
